viewing_check: Inside crown rivet and rim/liner for maker, date and broad arrow stamps (e.g. 1939-41 dates). Check whether SC paint sits over original paint and is aged (rust under/within lettering, paint on rust) or looks fresh/modern; check liner and chinstrap dates. Photograph the interior stamps.
